description: Craft Agents and Octomind through their vendors' PowerShell installers, and Codewhale and Momentic's Mo from npm, on Windows. Craft Agents' installer starts the app, which setup stops; the three CLIs are not run.
why: Octomind's witness is its launcher under %LOCALAPPDATA%\octomind\bin\ alone, and each npm package is its agent's only witness, because none of the three CLIs is run: forbid_rows holds ~\.codewhale, which a first run writes, absent. Craft Agents has three witnesses: the Uninstall key its installer writes, the launcher install-app.ps1 adds, and ~\.craft-agent, which the app writes when the installer starts it. require_rows holds all three, so removing any one value leaves the others to find it. forbid_rows holds the app stopped, and require_rows holds its executable at the path forbid_rows names, so a moved install fails here rather than leaving that row unable to match. claude-code and claude-desktop are forbidden because Craft Agents embeds the Claude Agent SDK and its native `claude` binary, pi because it embeds the Pi SDK, deepseek-harness because Codewhale started as deepseek-tui and defaults to DeepSeek's models, and hermes and warp because their launchers are read by the same per-user branch.
known_gaps: Craft Agents' installer starts the app and setup stops it, so it is not proved running, and no agent here is signed in: what each writes in use is not read.
Codewhale's archive installer, which writes %USERPROFILE%\bin, is not exercised; no Windows branch reads that directory.
